question_text: Describe how a supervised decision tree could classify a new software test run as likely to fail or likely to pass.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Train on labelled past runs with input features and pass/fail outcomes. The tree learns feature-based splits; the new run follows the applicable decisions to a leaf that provides a class prediction. Evaluate on independent labelled examples.
